headline: Vamos Net Profit Surges 199% to R$ 150.9 Million in Q3
summary: Brazilian truck rental firm Vamos, controlled by Simpar, reported a 199.1% year-on-year increase in third-quarter net profit to R$ 150.9 million, driven by strong sector demand and higher profitability.
why: Vamos is the leading heavy vehicle and equipment rental company in Brazil, serving as a bellwether for domestic logistics, agribusiness, and industrial transportation.

impacts.name: Grupo Vamos SA
impacts.why: Net profit tripled year-on-year on broad demand across serviced sectors.
